name: TM7 Banana and Chocolate Chip Loaf
ingredients: 125 g unsalted butter, softened, plus extra for greasing
120 g milk or dark chocolate chips (100 g for batter, 20 g for topping)

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 160°C fan / 180°C conventional. Grease and line a 2 lb loaf tin with baking paper.
Add 125 g softened unsalted butter and 120 g light brown sugar to the mixing bowl. Mix 30 sec / speed 4. No butterfly needed.
Scrape down the sides of the bowl, then mix 20 sec / speed 4.
Add 250 g peeled ripe bananas, 2 large eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Mix 20 sec / speed 4. Scrape down the bowl. The mixture may look slightly curdled; this is fine.
Add 225 g self-raising flour, 1/2 tsp bicarbonate of soda and a pinch of salt. Mix 10 sec / speed 3. Scrape down and finish folding with the spatula until no dry flour remains. Avoid overmixing.
Use the spatula to fold in 100 g chocolate chips.
Spoon the mixture into the prepared loaf tin and level gently. Sprinkle the remaining 20 g chocolate chips over the top.

Bake at 160°C fan / 180°C conventional for 55-65 minutes, checking from 50 minutes. A skewer inserted into the centre should come out without wet batter; melted chocolate is fine. If the top gets dark before the middle is cooked, loosely cover with foil.

Leave in the tin for 15 minutes, then lift onto a wire rack. Allow to cool before slicing so the middle holds together. Makes approximately 10 slices. Use very ripe bananas with plenty of brown spots for the best flavour.
